evaluator_expectations: Soundness of the concept and credibility of the proposed methodology

Extent to which the proposal demonstrates a clear understanding of the state-of-the-art in AI agent architectures, planning mechanisms, memory management, reasoning capabilities, and multi-agent frameworks
Quality and appropriateness of the research methodology and associated work plan
Clarity and pertinence of the objectives
Extent to which the proposal addresses novel and ambitious scientific and technological challenges
Quality of the interdisciplinary approach (where relevant)
Extent to which the outputs of the project would contribute to the Apply AI Strategy
Credibility of the plan for deployment via European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIHs) and Testing and Experiment Facilities
Quality of the plan for sharing results via the AI-on-demand platform
Extent to which the proposal addresses at least one of the target sectors: healthcare, advanced manufacturing, or in-vehicle autonomous driving
Appropriateness of measures for the dissemination and exploitation of results
Contribution to EU competitiveness and strategic autonomy in AI
Potential societal impact and alignment with EU values
Quality and effectiveness of the work plan, including the extent to which the resources assigned to work packages are in line with their objectives and deliverables
Appropriateness of the management structures and procedures
Inclusion of KPIs, benchmarking mechanisms, and progress monitoring
Allocation of tasks for ADRA cohesion activities and GenAI4EU Hub collaboration
Evidence of building on previous funded actions and linking to AI Factories and Data Labs resources
Complementarity and balance of the consortium
Quality and relevant experience of the individual participants

criteria.threshold_note: No individual per-criterion threshold for single-stage PF; only the overall 70/100 threshold applies. Weighting is used for ranking only.
evaluator_expectations: This is a procedural selection criterion, not a scored evaluation criterion. Grants will be awarded not only in order of ranking but also to ensure at least one funded proposal per sector: healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving — subject to all evaluation thresholds being passed.

instruments.overall_threshold: 70/100 (weighted sum of the three criterion scores)

Soundness of the proposed methodology (including interdisciplinary approaches, consideration of the gender dimension and other diversity aspects if relevant, and the quality and appropriateness of open science practices).
Quality of the supervision, training and of the two-way transfer of knowledge between the researcher and the host.
Quality and appropriateness of the researcher's professional experience, competences and skills.

Suitability and quality of the measures to maximise expected outcomes and impacts, as set out in the dissemination and exploitation plan, including communication activities.
The magnitude and importance of the project's contribution to the expected scientific, societal and economic impacts.
